title: Lone Wolfe - rain on me.
htmlContent:
Creativity and innovation is what you get from Lone Wolfe on his new song “rain on me.”. The sound is engaging with creative production that sets the perfect engaging tone, with his unique approach to the vocals having a special quality to it that makes you listen to every word. The lyrics match the music to perfection and helps push this record to the next level to make it must hear.
